_about: The sofa line-up (Nani's sitting room), camera E, on the 1600x900 design. Layout spec before art (design 9.4): suspects stand behind the sofa back and rest their hands or paws on its top edge; the occluder hides everything below it, so a suspect who sits down slides out of sight. Nothing that can be tapped sits under the magnifier inset. Greybox: every shape is drawn in code from these numbers.
